# The lever table from data, DEVELOPMENT laboratories only (step 5's rival)

*Generated by `scripts/generators/build_lever_table.py` under `docs/reference/lever_table/PREREG.md`. Every number is estimated from double-keyed within-study contrasts in the literature; no engine output enters. Read the new-laboratory interval: it is what a formulator should expect in their own pot.*

**What this table cannot do.** Published contrasts are a selected sample (a lever that did nothing is under-reported), so a pooled effect is an upper estimate of the typical one. Most contrasts are model systems in buffer; a cell names its matrices and does not claim to transfer to a plant-protein product. A cell reports what happened, not why, and predicts no combination of levers that no study varied together.

- Sources 17, contrasts used 147, laboratories 7; not used: mixed-lever contrasts (no single-lever cell) 31; fewer than two usable arms 47; sugar-identity contrasts whose levels are not sugars (fed intermediates) 2; rates, half-lives or storage losses (PREREG amendment A1) 42.
